question: In which of the Five-Year Plans was 'The Twenty Point Programme' launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Twenty Point Programme was launched in India during the Fifth Five-Year Plan period (1974-79).
 
• It was introduced by Prime Minister Indira Gandhi on 1st July 1975.
 
• The programme aimed at poverty eradication, employment generation, and improvement of quality of life.
 
• The focus was on areas like health, education, housing, and social welfare to uplift the marginalized sections of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India**

 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were centralized economic and social growth programs modeled after the Soviet Union's planning system.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing on agriculture and infrastructure development.
 
• The plans aimed to achieve self-reliant and robust economic growth, reducing poverty, and improving living standards.
 
 
 
• **Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-79)**
 
 
• It aimed at economic self-reliance and poverty reduction, with a focus on employment generation.
 
• Major projects included the National Program for Minimum Needs and the Twenty Point Programme.
 
• The plan faced challenges due to the global oil crisis and inflationary pressures.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi's Policies**
 
 
• Indira Gandhi, the then Prime Minister, introduced several socio-economic reforms in the 1970s.
 
• Her policies focused on poverty alleviation, land reforms, and increasing agricultural productivity.
 
• She nationalized banks in 1969 to ensure credit availability to the underprivileged.
 
 
 
• **Poverty Alleviation Programs**
 
 
• India has implemented various programs to alleviate poverty, such as the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA).
 
• These programs aim to provide employment, improve infrastructure, and support vulnerable populations.
